description: This Java source file defines the AttractionListActivity class, which is an Android activity responsible for displaying a list of tourist attractions sorted by distance. It manages location permissions, interacts with utility services for location updates and geofencing, and provides debug options via menu items.

classes.name: AttractionListActivity
classes.description: Main activity displaying a list of attractions, handling location permissions, and providing debug options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, manages location permission requests, and loads the fragment.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Requests location updates when activity resumes.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for testing notifications, microapp, and toggling geofence.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of location permission requests.

methods.name: requestFineLocationPermission
methods.description: Requests fine location permission from the user.

methods.name: fineLocationPermissionGranted
methods.description: Executes actions when location permission is granted, such as adding geofences and requesting location.

methods.name: showPermissionSnackbar
methods.description: Displays a snackbar explaining why location permission is needed.

methods.name: showDebugDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog with debug information.
